sections.title: Field Bibliography
sections.description: This course is essentially an independent study, undertaken by doctoral students in preparation for the Candidacy Examination. This course should be taken in conjunction with ARCH 8520 after all other courses have been completed. Normally a member of the student's Dissertation Committee supervises this course.
